## The Hideout: 4-Story Slide, Glow Golf, & Rope Bridges

Sevierville, TN, United States



20 guests

5 bedrooms

6 bathrooms

Escape to the Extraordinary at The Hideout

Nestled in the Smoky Mountains, The Hideout is a four-story treetop retreat where luxury, adventure, and imagination converge. Spiral down a 37' tall glass slide into a glow-in-the-dark mini golf haven, cross suspended rope bridges linking cabins with panoramic forest views, and enjoy five curated luxury bedrooms, a swim spa, high end game room, outdoor bowling, sauna, sunken fire pit, yard games & more. Everything you need for an unforgettable escape!

### Good to know

Escape to the Extraordinary at The Hideout. We are thrilled to welcome you to our newest, one-of-a-kind Smoky Mountain retreat. While this property is a fresh addition to our collection, we bring years of experience and a legacy of over 2,000 five-star reviews across the Smokies. Your stay here promises to be exceptional, seamless, and unforgettable. From the moment you arrive down the private driveway, you’ll know this is no ordinary getaway. The Hideout is a uniquely curated treetop experience, designed to delight at every turn. The main building features the glow-in-the-dark mini golf haven, living room, gourmet kitchen, outdoor kitchen, and an epic game room, all flowing together for both luxury and adventure.

Spiral up to the fourth floor and discover breathtaking forest views, a giant tree stump entrance hiding a four-story glass spiral slide, a barrel sauna, and our mirror cabin with floor-to-ceiling panoramic forest vistas. Adventure and luxury are woven seamlessly into every detail. The property features five individually curated detached units, each with a private bedroom and ensuite bath, inspired by nature-luxury design. These units offer privacy, comfort, and a touch of magic, ideal for families or groups.

Step outside to your resort-style backyard, designed to delight all ages, featuring a 20' swim spa (hot tub plus small pool), a massive sunken fire pit for evenings under the stars, barrel yard games including Plinko, ring toss, axe throwing, and skeeball, and a two-lane outdoor bowling alley. Guests also enjoy exclusive access to a one of a kind commercial grade glow-in-the-dark three-hole mini golf course. The main-level wraparound deck offers sweeping forest views, an outdoor kitchen with gas grill and pizza oven, and a dining table for 12. The perfect backdrop for meals with family or friends. From sunrise to starlight, every outdoor moment invites connection, laughter, and relaxation.

Entertainment is thoughtfully woven into every level of The Hideout. The upper-level game room is like nothing you’ve ever experienced, featuring commercial-grade arcade games including 4 player Halo, the world's largest Pac-Man, and a four-person sit-down Nitro racing arcade, plus a poker table, pool table, and multicade barrel arcade with 150+ classic games. The fun continues downstairs with glow-in-the-dark mini golf and a kids treehouse adventure den.

The kitchen serves as the heart of the home, fully equipped with a 48 inch, 8 burner stainless steel range and all cookware needed for everything from leisurely breakfasts to gourmet group dinners. A ten-person waterfall island and a six-seat bar table offer flexible seating, while a glass floor allows guests to watch the fun unfold as people finish the 4 story slide into the mini golf room below. Floor-to-ceiling windows frame the treetops and offer a perfect view of the four-story slide.

The Hideout’s five individually curated units blend luxury, comfort, and forest inspiration. Each unit is connected to the main house through rope suspension bridges and elevated walkways that all provide guests with a bedroom and ensuite private bathroom.

Stargazer on the fourth floor features a king suite, desk, and TV.

The Hollow on the second floor offers a king suite with two trundle cots for children, a desk, and a private deck.

The Cave on the second floor, includes a king suite, desk, and TV, accessed via a suspension rope bridge.

The Grove on the second floor has a king bed plus four twin beds and a private deck.

The Canopy on the third floor offers a king bed, two trundle cots for children, a desk, and a private deck with floating net.

The Hideout is more than a vacation home. It’s a fully immersive, self-contained forest retreat. From treetop slides to glow-in-the-dark mini golf, rope bridges, mirrored cabins, and endless games. Everything you need is right here! Escape the ordinary, recharge, and create memories that will last a lifetime. All without ever leaving the property.

ADDITIONAL AMENITIES –
• Cozy 20' swim spa year round with 7 person hot tub and small swimming pool
• 4 person Halo, World's Largest Pac Man, 4 seat racing arcade game, pool table, poker table, barrel arcade
• High-speed Wi-Fi internet access
• Washer and dryer available to use during your stay.
• Heating & A/C
• Parking for 8 standard-size vehicles.
• We provide a set of starter supplies to allow you to get settled when you arrive. They include 2 trash bags, 2 dishwasher pods, a paper towel roll, a small liquid dish soap bottle, toilet paper, shampoo, conditioner, body lotion, body wash, and a soap bar for each bathroom, towels, a bed, and linens. They are designed so that you are all set when you arrive, but not to last the entire trip.
• Less than 4 miles from downtown Gatlinburg, and access to all the area has to offer, which includes its great restaurants, shopping & the Smoky Mountain National Park.
• Less than 3 Miles to Pigeon Forge & 7 miles away from the entrance to Dollywood/Splash Country!
• Our proximity to the Great Smoky Mountain National Park means there is lots of wildlife in our area - black bears, deer, wild turkeys, raccoons, coyotes, foxes, and more! Black bears visit the cabin often in Spring, Summer, and Fall. You may get lucky and catch a glimpse of one of these residents while enjoying the view from the deck. We also contract regular monthly pest services, which treat all pests from multiple types of bugs, mice, etc. Despite our regular treatments, given the proximity of the cabin to the park, it is possible these pests can temporarily enter the cabin. We immediately respond and treat if anything comes up, and have found it is very rare to come across anything like this.

PLEASE NOTE: This unique retreat requires the navigation of stairs to each & every space, a part of the treetop adventure. To reach the main level it involves 20 steps from the parking area. Our additional units are accessed via suspension rope bridges & additional sets of stairs/spiral stairs, so guests should plan accordingly for luggage and groceries. The external walkways and rope bridges could get slippery in inclement weather. The rope bridges move while navigating them so please always use caution while staying.

### Accessibility and Availability

#### Neighborhood

Neighborhood Highlights
Escape the hustle and bustle and immerse yourself in the natural beauty of the Great Smoky Mountains! Our treehouse offers the ultimate blend of peaceful seclusion and incredible access to local attractions.

Your Private Forest Sanctuary
Nestled on a sprawling, beautifully private forested 8-acre forest, the property provides an unparalleled sense of peace and privacy. Wake up to the sound of rustling leaves and singing birds, enjoy your morning coffee surrounded by towering trees, and breathe in the crisp mountain air. It is a truly serene backdrop where you can disconnect and recharge.

A Fantastic Smokies Location
Despite feeling worlds away, you are perfectly positioned to experience the very best of the area. You are just a short drive from the majestic Great Smoky Mountains National Park, offering endless opportunities for hiking, scenic drives, and wildlife viewing. When you are ready for a night out, the charming shops, excellent dining, and lively entertainment of downtown Gatlinburg are incredibly accessible. You truly get the best of both worlds here!

Important Note for Our Guests:
The cabin is located on a mountain road. We strongly recommend trip insurance, especially during the Winter since there are no refunds for snow and ice. In difficult winter or storm-related weather situations, there can be delays in cleaning and check-in pending road conditions which can be outside of our control.

#### Guest Access

Our guests will have the property to themselves! It sits on an serene 8 acre parcel in the heart of the Great Smoky Mountains.

Book your stay

### Find us

#### Sevierville, TN, United States

Many of our guests drive to Gatlinburg Tennessee, but some also choose to fly into the Knoxville airport, McGhee Tyson Airport 44 miles away. We highly recommend that our guests have a vehicle for transportation and one with 4 wheel drive in the winter season. There's just so much to see and do in Gatlinburg and the surrounding areas!

## Mauna Nani

Gatlinburg, TN, United States



16 guests

7 bedrooms

4 bathrooms

Welcome to Mauna Nani, a brand-new, custom-built luxury cabin where breathtaking Smoky Mountain views meet modern design and upscale comfort. With 7 bedrooms, 4 bathrooms, and sleeps 16 guests, this home was thoughtfully designed for families, friends, and groups who want the perfect mix of relaxation and entertainment.

### Good to know

Plan your perfect spring escape at our cozy cabin, where fresh mountain air, blooming landscapes, and peaceful surroundings create the perfect setting for a relaxing getaway. Start your mornings on the porch with a cup of coffee, take in the sights and sounds of nature coming back to life, and unwind as the sun sets behind the mountains. Your springtime retreat is waiting. Come make it yours!

From the moment you enter, you’ll be greeted by a large, beautiful tree fountain, a unique feature that immediately sets the tone for your stay. The soothing sound of water pairs perfectly with the soaring ceilings, custom finishes, and walls of windows that frame the mountains. The main level is the heart of the home, featuring a spacious living room with a seasonal electric fireplace and Smart TV, and opening onto expansive decks with outdoor dining and lounge seating. Just off the deck, the game room brings non-stop fun with a full-size pool table that flips into air hockey, foosball, and six multi-game arcade consoles. ### Accessibility and Availability

#### Neighborhood

The cabin is in the premier community of Chalet Village, Gatlinburg, Tennessee, and our property is adjacent to the Great Smoky Mountain National Park. The views from the cabin of the Great Smoky Mountains are breathtaking and we are only 3 miles from downtown Gatlinburg and the entrance to the Smoky Mountains National Park!

Our close proximity to the Great Smoky Mountain National Park means there is lots of wildlife in our area - black bears, deer, wild turkeys, raccoons, coyotes, foxes, and more! Black bears visit the cabin often in Spring, Summer, and Fall. You may get lucky and catch a glimpse of one of these residents while enjoying the view from the deck. We also contract regular monthly pest services which treat all pests from multiple types of bugs, mice, etc. Despite our regular treatments, given the proximity of the cabin to the park, it is possible these pests can temporarily enter the cabin. We immediately respond and treat if anything comes up and have found it is rare to come across anything like this.

When you've had enough relaxation, look forward to endless entertainment in the surrounding area; you'll be in the perfect spot to explore through winding hiking trails and world-class ski slopes in the Great Smoky Mountains. Other local attractions can be found in downtown Gatlinburg, including delectable restaurants, intriguing shops, the always-entertaining alpine slides, and even a moonshine distillery! During your time here, make sure to visit the Ober Gatlinburg Amusement Park & Ski Area, which offers terrific skiing in the colder months, a ski mountain coaster, an aerial tramway, and many other thrilling attractions!

The cabin is located on a mountain road. We strongly recommend trip insurance, especially during the Winter since there are no refunds for snow and ice. In difficult winter or storm-related weather situations, there can be delays in cleaning and check-in pending road conditions which can be outside of our control.

Welcome to Laughing Bear Lodge, where big groups experience the Smokies in style. Sleeping 26 across 10 bedrooms, including immersive themed rooms and four king suites with private baths, this lodge was made for memorable stays. Laughing Bear Lodge sleeps 26 and is located in The Preserve Resort, a quiet mountain community perched above scenic Wears Valley. With 10 bedrooms across 3 levels, including 4 king suites with private bathrooms, themed bunk rooms for the kids and a starry-sky loft, there's room for the whole crew to spread out and still come together for meals, games and movie nights.

Entertainment is endless at Laughing Bear Lodge. Head downstairs to the private movie theater, where rows of red recliners, a popcorn machine and a stack of board games set the stage for family movie night. Then climb to the top floor game room for arcade games, air hockey, pool, shuffleboard and a poker table for game night. When it's time to head outside, the lower deck is your own backyard playground with a private hot tub, an outdoor bowling lane, a putting green and giant Connect Four.

At Laughing Bear Lodge, you're not just booking a cabin, you're booking a mountain getaway where every day can be filled with movie marathons, arcade battles, bowling rematches, hot tub soaks and long dinners on the porch. Book your stay and let the memories begin!

On the top floor, the game room is packed with arcade games, air hockey, pool, shuffleboard and a poker table, with a loft overhead. Bright, lively, and loaded with things to do, this recreation area turns downtime into one of the best parts of your stay.

From breathtaking mountain views and spectacular sunsets to a private hot tub, outdoor bowling alley, arcade-packed game room, immersive gaming den, private theater, and one-of-a-kind bunk room with its own slide, Chestnut Cabin brings the fun of a family resort right to your cabin.

### Good to know

We’re thrilled to welcome you to Chestnut Cabin, one of the newest additions to our collection! With years of experience hosting guests in the Smokies and over 2,000+ 5-star reviews across our properties, we’re committed to providing an exceptional stay. While this is a new account for properties we manage on behalf of friends and family, rest assured that your experience will be nothing short of spectacular.

Chestnut Cabin was made for family fun and unforgettable mountain memories! Gather together in the spacious living room with soaring wood ceilings and a cozy stone fireplace, then let the fun begin. Challenge the family in the arcade-packed game room with pool, shuffleboard, darts, Mortal Kombat, Ms. Pac-Man, a driving game, and more, or head downstairs to the Gaming Den with two Xbox systems. Movie nights get even better in your private theater with reclining seating, while the kids will love their one-of-a-kind mountain-themed bunk room featuring its very own tube slide!

The fun continues outside with an amenity you definitely don't find at every mountain cabin: your own private outdoor bowling lane! See who can bowl the first strike, then unwind together in the private hot tub or find your favorite spot on one of the multiple decks to enjoy the fresh mountain air and beautiful Smoky Mountain scenery. Whether your perfect family vacation includes arcade battles, Xbox tournaments, outdoor bowling competitions, movie marathons, racing down the bunk-room slide, soaking in the hot tub, or simply spending time together around the fireplace, Chestnut Cabin gives you countless ways to make memories without ever leaving the property.

At Chestnut Cabin, you’re not simply booking a place to stay, you’re giving the whole family a Smoky Mountain vacation they’ll be talking about long after they head home!

KITCHEN -
The kitchen is designed to make cooking for a crowd easy and enjoyable. Featuring granite countertops, a spacious kitchen island, stainless steel appliances, ample counter space, and a fully stocked kitchen with cooking essentials, you'll have everything you need for family breakfasts, home-cooked dinners, and late-night snacks. Coffee lovers can choose between a Keurig and a traditional drip coffee maker to get each morning started right. The open-concept design connects the kitchen directly to the dining and living spaces, so whoever is cooking can still be part of the fun. The large dining table offers seating for 8, with 2 additional seats at the kitchen island and another 3 at the high-top behind the couch, creating plenty of options for your group to gather together.

OUTDOOR AREAS AND DECKS-
The outdoor spaces at Chestnut Cabin are every bit as fun as the inside! Multiple levels of decks offer outdoor chairs and side tables where you can relax, enjoy the fresh mountain air, and take in the beautiful surrounding scenery and sunsets. On the lower deck, soak your cares away in the private hot tub after a full day exploring the Smokies. Then challenge the family to something you don't find at your average mountain cabin: your own outdoor bowling lane! Set up the pins, grab a bowling ball, and see who earns bragging rights for the vacation. A gas grill is also available for cookouts, while the various decks provide plenty of places to slow down and enjoy your time in the mountains.

RECREATION AREA -

The main level welcomes you with a bright, open-concept layout where the living room, kitchen, and dining area come together seamlessly. From the moment you walk through the front door, you'll feel right at home. The soaring ceilings, cozy stone fireplace, and wall of windows overlooking the Smoky Mountains create a warm and welcoming atmosphere that invites everyone to slow down and simply enjoy being together. Whether you're gathered around the dining table sharing stories from the day's adventures, curled up by the fire with hot chocolate, or watching the sunrise over the mountains with your morning coffee, Thunder Mountain Sanctuary is the kind of place where lifelong traditions begin.

The fun never has to stop! Kids will spend hours splashing in the private indoor heated pool, challenging each other to a game of shuffleboard or air hockey, and gathering for family movie nights in the private theater room. After a day exploring Dollywood, hiking in the Great Smoky Mountains National Park, or shopping in Pigeon Forge, everyone can relax in the bubbling hot tub while the kids roast marshmallows around the outdoor fire pit. Whether you're celebrating a birthday or simply escaping for a much-needed vacation, every space has been designed to help families reconnect, laugh a little louder, and make memories they'll talk about for years to come.

The heart of every family vacation is time spent around the table, and Thunder Mountain Sanctuary was built with that in mind. The spacious, fully equipped kitchen features stainless steel appliances, granite countertops, and everything needed to prepare everything from pancake breakfasts to holiday dinners. The open-concept layout allows the chef to stay part of the conversation while meals are prepared, and the large dining table offers plenty of room for everyone to gather together. Whether you're enjoying pizza after a day at Dollywood or cooking your family's favorite recipes, this is where some of the best vacation memories are made.

OUTDOOR AREAS AND DECKS-
There's nothing quite like ending a Smoky Mountain day outdoors. Spend your mornings watching the mountains come alive with a cup of coffee, enjoy family cookouts on the gas grill, or gather on the deck to watch the sunset paint the mountains in shades of gold and orange. As evening falls, soak in the private hot tub while the kids make s'mores around the fire pit, and everyone shares stories beneath a sky full of stars. These outdoor spaces were designed to help you unplug, reconnect, and enjoy every moment together.

RECREATION AREA -
Rain or shine, there's something for everyone at Thunder Mountain Sanctuary. The private indoor heated pool means swimming season never ends, while the arcade offers hours of friendly family competition. When it's time to wind down, grab the popcorn and settle into the private theater room for movie night. From toddlers to grandparents, every generation will find something they love, making this the perfect destination for families traveling together.

## Forest Vista Lodge

Welcome to Forest Vista Lodge, where mountain views, family fun, and Southern hospitality come together! Designed for families and groups, this spacious 5-bedroom cabin offers room to spread out and plenty of ways to reconnect. Enjoy two game-filled recreation areas, arcade games, a pool table, shuffleboard, foosball, outdoor bowling, a private hot tub, and cozy fireside spaces. With something for every generation, it’s the perfect home base for an unforgettable Smoky Mountain getaway!

### Good to know

We’re thrilled to welcome you to Forest Vista Lodge, our newest cabin! With years of experience hosting guests in the Smokies and over 2,000+ 5-star reviews across our properties, we’re committed to providing an exceptional stay. While this is a new account for properties we manage on behalf of friends and family, rest assured that your experience will be nothing short of spectacular.

Forest Vista Lodge is located in Sherwood Forest Resort, one of Pigeon Forge’s premier gated mountain communities. This beautiful community combines peaceful mountain surroundings with convenient access to everything the area has to offer. Guests also have access to the resort’s seasonal outdoor community swimming pool, giving families another great way to cool off and enjoy their time in the Smokies. It’s the perfect home base for families and groups who want to experience the mountains together.

Entertainment is endless at Forest Vista Lodge. Head upstairs to the loft and let the friendly competition begin with a pool table and an incredible lineup of arcade games. Downstairs, the second recreation area keeps the fun going with shuffleboard, soccer foosball, hockey foosball, and a custom-painted bear mural illuminated by black light. Then take the competition outside, where the lower deck features a soccer kicking game and two lanes of outdoor bowling. Whether the kids are battling for the arcade high score, the adults are starting a pool tournament, or the entire family is competing for bowling bragging rights, there’s plenty here to keep everyone entertained.

At Forest Vista Lodge, you’re not just booking a cabin; you’re creating a place for the whole family to reconnect. Spend your mornings sipping coffee surrounded by the trees, your afternoons exploring the Smokies, and your evenings playing games, gathering around the fireplace, or relaxing together in the private hot tub. From our family to yours, we can’t wait to welcome you to Forest Vista Lodge and help make your Smoky Mountain getaway one to remember!

KITCHEN -
The kitchen is designed to make cooking for the whole family easy and enjoyable. Featuring a large kitchen island, plenty of counter space, and ample room to prepare a family meal, you’ll have a comfortable place for everything from big breakfasts before heading into Pigeon Forge to homemade dinners and late-night snacks. The open-concept design connects the kitchen to the dining and living spaces, so no one has to miss out on the fun while preparing meals. A large dining table provides seating for 10, with two additional seats at the kitchen island, giving the group plenty of room to gather for meals, games, and time together.

OUTDOOR AREAS AND DECKS-
The outdoor spaces at Forest Vista Lodge are made for enjoying the peaceful Smoky Mountain surroundings together. Step onto the covered decks and settle into an Adirondack chair or rocking chair with your morning coffee, enjoy the fresh mountain air surrounded by the trees, or spend some time playing together on the lower deck. The outdoor entertainment includes a soccer kicking game and two lanes of bowling, giving kids and adults another fun place for a little friendly competition. When you’re ready to relax, sink into the private hot tub and unwind after a day of hiking, exploring Pigeon Forge, or chasing the kids around Dollywood. Guests also have access to Sherwood Forest Resort’s seasonal outdoor community pool, perfect for cooling off on warm Smoky Mountain days. Whether you’re starting the morning slowly or ending the evening together, there are plenty of ways to get outside and enjoy your mountain getaway.

RECREATION AREA -
The recreation areas at Forest Vista Lodge are your destination for fun, laughter, and unforgettable family competition. Head to the top-floor loft for a game of pool or see who can claim the high score on the arcade games, including Golden Tee, Pac-Man, NBA Jam, Atari, and Dig Dug. Downstairs, another game room features shuffleboard, soccer foosball, hockey foosball, and a custom-painted bear mural illuminated with black light. The fun continues outside with a soccer kicking game and two lanes of outdoor bowling. From kids challenging the adults in the arcade to family pool tournaments and late-night games after a day exploring the Smokies, there’s something here for guests of all ages.

## White Pine Cabin

Pigeon Forge, TN, United States



12 guests

Welcome to White Pine, your spacious Smoky Mountain retreat featuring an incredible game room with 5 arcade games, shuffleboard, private hot tub, outdoor bowling, large tube slide, wood-burning firepit, and multiple outdoor living spaces. With 5 bedrooms and plenty of room to gather across three levels, this beautiful cabin is the perfect setting for family vacations, group getaways, and unforgettable trips to the Smokies.

### Good to know

We’re thrilled to welcome you to White Pine, our newest cabin! With years of experience hosting guests in the Smokies and over 2,000+ 5-star reviews across our Stay Awhile Vacation Rentals properties, we’re committed to providing an exceptional stay. While this is a new account for properties we manage on behalf of friends and family, rest assured that your experience will be nothing short of spectacular.

Whether you're looking to spend your days competing in the game room, soaking in the private hot tub, challenging the family to outdoor bowling, racing down the large tube slide, or gathering around the wood-burning firepit, White Pine is packed with amenities designed to bring everyone together and make your time at the cabin just as memorable as your Smoky Mountain adventures.

KITCHEN -
The spacious kitchen at White Pine makes preparing meals and gathering together effortless. Featuring modern appliances, a large kitchen island, and plenty of room to prepare everything from a quick breakfast to a family dinner, the kitchen is designed with larger groups in mind. The open-concept layout flows seamlessly into the dining and living areas, allowing everyone to stay connected whether you're cooking, relaxing by the fireplace, or planning the day's Smoky Mountain adventures.

The large dining table offers seating for 10, with an additional 3 seats at the kitchen island and 3 more at the high-top table behind the couch, providing plenty of room for meals, games, and time together.

SPACIOUS OUTDOOR DECKS-
Step outside and enjoy White Pine's spacious outdoor living areas, with multiple levels offering plenty of room to relax and enjoy the peaceful mountain surroundings. The main-level deck features a comfortable sectional couch and rocking chairs, making it a wonderful place to enjoy your morning coffee, catch up with family, or simply slow down and take in the fresh mountain air.

Head to the lower deck for even more fun and relaxation, where you'll find a private hot tub, two hanging swings, and outdoor bowling complete with a custom mural. Whether you're soaking in the hot tub after a day of exploring, enjoying a little friendly competition, or simply spending an evening outside together, there are plenty of ways to enjoy the outdoors without leaving the cabin.

MULTIPLE RECREATION AREAS -
White Pine is packed with entertainment for guests of all ages. The lower-level game room creates the perfect place for family and friends to gather for a little friendly competition, with a pool table, shuffleboard, skee-ball, and an impressive collection of arcade games including Mortal Kombat, Pac-Man, Fast & Furious, Golden Tee, and Midway Defender.

When you're ready to wind down, the lower-level TV area can transform into your own private theater space! Simply close the drapes to separate the TV room from the rest of the game room, creating a cozy, private setting for movie nights with the whole family. Settle into the large sectional, dim the lights, and enjoy your favorite movie or show after a fun-filled day in the Smokies.

The fun continues outdoors with one of White Pine's most unique amenities, a large tube slide that takes you from the lower deck down to the firepit area! At the bottom, gather around the wood-burning firepit in the Adirondack chairs, roast marshmallows, tell stories, and enjoy evenings together beneath the Smoky Mountain sky.

The lower level of the cabin has a game room complete with:
• Large game room with pool table, shuffleboard, skee-ball, and arcade games (Mortal Kombat, Pac-Man, Fast & Furious, Golden Tee & Midway Defender arcade games)

Driveway & Access-
The final 100 yards of the drive to White Pine are on a gravel road that leads directly to the cabin. We recommend guests arrive in an SUV or truck for easier access to the property. Please plan your transportation accordingly, particularly when traveling during inclement weather.

ADDITIONAL AMENITIES –
• Private hot tub
• Large game room with pool table, shuffleboard, skee-ball, and arcade games (Mortal Kombat, Pac-Man, Fast & Furious, Golden Tee & Midway Defender arcade games)

They are designed so that you are all set when you arrive, but not to last the entire trip.

Your springtime retreat is waiting. Come make it yours!

LIVING ROOM – Awe-inspiring two-story windows at Mountain Bearadise cabin have a 2-story custom oak tree wood carving from a renowned local artist opening up to panoramic views of Downtown Gatlinburg, Ober Gatlinburg Gondola & the Great Smoky Mountains National Park! The living room connects to the kitchen and dining room with a beautiful, two-story, gas fireplace, setting this great room apart and making it perfect for entertaining! It is warm, cozy, and ready for you to relax and enjoy the views or binge-watch from the 55" HD Flat Screen TV & brand new, plush leather furniture. This unique cabin has a very large, private backyard with a large private firepit, outdoor dining table, and beautiful wooden rockers. Fireplace season is October through March.

MULTIPLE RECREATION AREAS

KITCHEN – Well-appointed with all the major utensils, silverware, dishes, glasses and cookware needed for you to create & serve gourmet meals. Electric stove, oven, microwave, refrigerator, dishwasher, Keurig coffee maker, drip coffee maker, toaster, etc.

## Big Bear Cabin

Gatlinburg, TN, United States



14 guests

5 bedrooms

3 bathrooms

Big Bear Cabin is a 5-bedroom, 3,024 sqft, private mountain retreat, with stunning views of The Great Smoky Mountains, located less than 10 min (2.5 miles) from downtown Gatlinburg & the National Park entrance. 3 story cabin sleeps 14 people & packed with activities designed for entertainment including a hot tub, pool table, Foosball, arcade games, custom log poker table, outdoor fire pit, access to community pools (2.1 miles away), kitchen stocked with all major cooking utensils, etc

### Good to know

Plan your perfect spring escape at our cozy cabin, where fresh mountain air, blooming landscapes, and peaceful surroundings create the perfect setting for a relaxing getaway. Start your mornings on the porch with a cup of coffee, take in the sights and sounds of nature coming back to life, and unwind as the sun sets behind the mountains. Your springtime retreat is waiting. Come make it yours!

LIVING ROOM – Awe-inspiring two-story windows opening up to panoramic views of the Great Smoky Mountain National Park and a large, two-story wood-burning fireplace set this room apart! It is warm, cozy, and ready for you to relax and enjoy the views or binge-watch from the 55" HD Flat Screen TV & plush leather furniture. Fireplace season is October through March.

MULTIPLE RECREATION AREAS
You never need to leave the cabin to enjoy your vacation with three separate entertainment areas to enjoy! These are filled with everything from classic pool tables and foosball to arcade games and TVs!

The first floor of the cabin has an expansive game room complete with:
• Full-size pool table
• Custom, hand-crafted log poker table
• Game cabinet with assorted board games
• 50” HD TV and full cable service
• Large outdoor deck with wonderful view & swinging bench
• Corn hole game for outdoor use
• Large wood burning fireplace
• Second full refrigerator in laundry room

Main floor (2nd story):
• Living room with 65” HD TV and full cable service & large wood burning fireplace
• Upper exterior deck with breathtaking panoramic views of the Great Smoky Mountains
• Library of books to read and relax in the fresh mountain air
• Hot tub with capacity for 7 people

Third floor game room:
• Custom arcade video game unit (no charge) with 60+ classic arcade games
• Foosball table

BEDROOMS
The cabin sleeps up to 14 guests with 5 comfortable bedrooms and two pull out sofas. Each bedroom is appointed with beautiful cabin themed quilts, hand crafted log frame beds and cozy comforters.

First floor (sleeps 6 people):
• Bedroom with 2 bed bunks (4 total twin beds)
• Bedroom with 1 queen bed
• Full bathroom

Main floor (2nd story – sleeps 5 people):
• Bedroom with King bed and 32” HD TV and full cable service
• Bedroom with Queen bed
• Living room with a pull-out sofa bed (twin bed)
• Full bathroom with a shower and ¾ tub

Third floor (sleeps 3 people):
• Bedroom with King bed and 43” HD TV and full cable service
• Game room with a pull-out sofa bed (double bed)
• Bathroom with full shower

BALCONY / DECKS - 3 Balconies, rocking chair seating, two outdoor dining tables, hot tub, outdoor fire pit off deck with hot tub, stunning views

DINING ROOM – Beautiful wooden cabin dining room with 10-12 person dining room table and a bar top in the kitchen with 3 bar stools.

KITCHEN – Well appointed with all the major utensils, silverware, dishes, glasses and cookware needed for you to create & serve gourmet meals. Electric stove, oven, microwave, refrigerator, dishwasher, Keurig coffee maker, drip coffee maker, toaster, etc.

ADDITIONAL AMENITIES –
• Access to Chalet Village Facilities which include 3 different club houses, three separate pool facilities, including water slide, a children’s play fountain, four tennis courts, Pickleball courts, two game rooms with pool table, foosball, air hockey, arcade games, children’s play structure, concession stands & more. These facilities are included with your stay, with seasonal swimming pools available from Memorial Day through Labor Day.
• Pet friendly with a fee
• Family Friendly! The cabin includes a Pack 'n Play (please bring your own sheet), high chair, children's books and toys, and children's dinnerware
• Safety items which include exterior facing security cameras, smoke/carbon monoxide alarms, fire extinguishers, and a first aid kit
• High-speed Wi-Fi
• Convenient location to all downtown Gatlinburg has to offer, which includes its great restaurants, shopping, Ripley's Aquarium, Ober Gatlinburg Ski Resort, & the entrance to The Great Smoky Mountains National Park all only a 7-10 minute drive (2.5 miles) away.
• Convenient access to Pigeon Forge, less than 9 miles away, with access to the Gatlinburg bypass, which allows you to avoid the peak season traffic in Gatlinburg on your way to Pigeon Forge attractions
• Only 13 miles away from the entrance to Dollywood/Splash Country!
• Just eight miles from this cabin is the beautiful Gatlinburg Community Center - a complex with indoor swimming pool, basketball court, ping pong, bowling alley, weight room and showers. For a very reasonable fee, visitors are welcome to take advantage of this beautiful complex.
• There is parking for approximately 4 standard size cars, if you double park, from a paved front driveway
• Heat, A/C, and laundry room with washer & dryer available
• Charcoal grill - guest to provide charcoal
• Additional conveniences such as an island in the kitchen which works well as a dedicated workspace, self check-in with smart locks, and the option for long-term stays
• We provide a set of starter supplies to allow you to get settled when you arrive. They include 2 trash bags, 2 dishwasher pods, a paper towel roll, a small liquid dish soap bottle, a toilet paper, a small bottle of shampoo, body lotion, body wash, conditioner and a soap bar for each bathroom, towels, and bed linens. They are designed so that you are all set when you arrive but not to last the entire trip.
• Our close proximity to the Great Smoky Mountain National Park means there is lots of wildlife in our area - black bears, deer, wild turkeys, raccoons, coyotes, fox, and more! Black bears visit the cabin often in Spring, Summer and Fall. You may get lucky and catch a glimpse of one of these residents while enjoying the view from the deck. We also contract regular monthly pest services which treat for all pests from multiple types of bugs, mice, etc. Despite our regular treatments, given the proximity of the cabin to the park, it is possible these pests can temporarily enter the cabin. We immediately respond and treat if anything comes up and have found it is rare to come across anything like this.

### Other Details to Note

We are in unprecedented times. The Coronavirus (COVID-19) outbreak continues to create stress and uncertainty for guests across the country. We are taking extra precautions to ensure guest safety:

• All hard & soft surfaces cleaned with Micro-Ban™ including: counters, vanities, sinks, floors, stair rails, cabinets, doors, furniture, beds, pillows, carpets, comforters, etc. throughout cabin.
• Lysol™ is used thoroughly on all compatible surfaces to clean and disinfect
• Bleach-based cleaners used in all bathrooms and kitchens, that allow use of chlorine products.
• Linens (bedding, towels, etc) – removed & washed offsite in temperatures exceeding those recommended for laundry operations, then packaged until the housekeeping staff are ready to put them out for guests.
• Hot Tub -- Drained, cleaned, fresh Bromine added and refilled after every guest
• Cabin inspected regularly after cleaning and inspectors perform additional applications of protective products in the cabin, such as MicroBan and Lysol.
• Cleaning staff received additional education on disinfection protocols and are furnished with protective gloves, changing them for fresh pairs as needed during cleaning & disinfection of the home.
• 2 Pets allowed with a fee. Fee is $288
• Please note that pet fees are automatically charged through Airbnb when pets are listed in the guest count.

### Accessibility and Availability

#### Neighborhood

The cabin is in the premier community of Chalet Village, Gatlinburg, Tennessee and our property is adjacent to the Great Smoky Mountain National Park. The views from cabin of the Great Smoky Mountains are breathtaking and we are only 2.5 miles from downtown Gatlinburg and the entrance to the Smoky Mountains National Park!

Our close proximity to the Great Smoky Mountain National Park means there is lots of wildlife in our area - black bears, deer, wild turkeys, raccoons, coyotes, fox, and more! Black bears visit the cabin often in Spring, Summer and Fall. You may get lucky and catch a glimpse of one of these residents while enjoying the view from the deck. We also contract regular monthly pest services which treat for all pests from multiple types of bugs, mice, etc. Despite our regular treatments, given the proximity of the cabin to the park, it is possible these pests can temporarily enter the cabin. We immediately respond and treat if anything comes up and have found it is rare to come across anything like this.

When you've had enough relaxation, look forward to endless entertainment in the surrounding area; you'll be in the perfect spot to explore through winding hiking trails and world-class ski slopes in the Great Smoky Mountains. Other local attractions can be found in downtown Gatlinburg, including delectable restaurants, intriguing shops, the always-entertaining alpine slides, and even a moonshine distillery! During your time here, make sure to visit the Ober Gatlinburg Amusement Park & Ski Area, which offers terrific skiing in the colder months, a ski mountain coaster, an aerial tramway, and many other thrilling attractions!

The cabin is located on a mountain road. We strongly recommend trip insurance, especially during the Winter since there are no refunds for snow and ice. In difficult winter or storm related weather situations there can be delays in cleaning and check-in pending road conditions which can be outside of our control.

#### Guest Access

Guests will have full access to the cabin! This is a private rental with no shared spaces other than the community pool.

Our family had an amazing stay at Big Bear Cabin! The cabin was beautiful, clean, and equipped with everything we needed. Morgan and Chris were wonderful hosts. Their communication before and throughout our stay was excellent, making everything seamless from start to finish.

The beds were incredibly comfortable with lots of extra blankets for snuggling up! The mountain views were even more breathtaking than the online photos, especially at sunset when the colors of the sky turned orange/pink.

My extended family that stayed at the cabin spanned several generations. There was something to keep every age group happily occupied. The pool table, Pac-Man arcade game and board games kept the teens and twenty-somethings entertained while the adults enjoyed coffee on the deck, taking in the spectacular scenery. Although we didn't have any babies/toddlers with us, we noticed thoughtful family-friendly touches like a highchair, playpen, and plastic plates and dishes for little ones.

One of the highlights of our trip was spotting a mama black bear with her two cubs. We even watched the cubs nurse (from a safe distance, of course)! It was an unforgettable wildlife experience!

We usually head to the Poconos for a cabin stay, but this trip to Gatlinburg was a wonderful change of pace and exceeded our expectations. We highly recommend Big Bear Cabin to anyone looking for a memorable mountain getaway.

## Treehouse Cabin

Sevierville, TN, United States



12 guests

3 bedrooms

3.5 bathrooms

Escape to the Smoky Mountains at this stunning 3-bedroom, 3.5-bath hilltop cabin right in the Smokies! Designed for relaxation and adventure, this pet-friendly retreat boasts breathtaking mountain views, two spacious wraparound decks, a private hot tub, and a game room packed with entertainment. Cozy up by the gas fireplace, roast marshmallows by the fire pit, or enjoy a family meal in the fully equipped kitchen.

### Good to know

Plan your perfect spring escape at our cozy cabin, where fresh mountain air, blooming landscapes, and peaceful surroundings create the perfect setting for a relaxing getaway. Start your mornings on the porch with a cup of coffee, take in the sights and sounds of nature coming back to life, and unwind as the sun sets behind the mountains. Your springtime retreat is waiting. Come make it yours!

Wake up to panoramic sunrise views, sip your coffee on the deck, and breathe in the fresh mountain air before heading out to explore Pigeon Forge, Gatlinburg, and the Great Smoky Mountains National Park, all just a short drive away. After a day of adventure, return to your cozy yet spacious home away from home to soak in the hot tub, gather around the fire pit, or challenge your group to a friendly game of pool.

Whether you’re planning a family getaway, a romantic retreat, or a fun trip with friends, this cabin has everything you need for an unforgettable Smoky Mountain stay.

We are thrilled to welcome you to The Treehouse, our newest cabin! With years of experience hosting guests in the Smokies and over 2000+ 5-star reviews across our properties, we’re committed to providing an exceptional stay. While this is a new account for properties we manage on behalf of friends and family, rest assured that your experience will be nothing short of spectacular.

LIVING AREAS -
Step inside and be welcomed by an inviting open-concept living space, featuring soaring ceilings, large picture windows, and a cozy gas fireplace that creates the perfect mountain retreat atmosphere. Sink into the comfy couches, catch up on your favorite shows on the Smart TV, or simply relax by the fire as you enjoy the peaceful surroundings.

SPACIOUS OUTDOOR AREA -
Step outside and experience true mountain living with plenty of outdoor amenities to enhance your stay. Unwind in the private hot tub, where you can soak away your stress while admiring the scenic surroundings. Gather around the wood-burning fire pit to roast marshmallows and tell stories under the starry sky. Fire up the gas grill for a delicious cookout with family and friends. Whether you're enjoying a peaceful evening by the fire or dining alfresco in the mountain air, this cabin’s outdoor space is designed for unforgettable moments.

KITCHEN -
The fully equipped kitchen has everything you need to prepare home-cooked meals with ease. Featuring modern appliances, ample counter space, and all the essentials, cooking is a breeze. Gather around one of the two dining tables for memorable meals with family and friends before heading out for a day of adventure.

DECKS -
One of the best features of this cabin is the two expansive wraparound decks, where you can take in the fresh mountain air and stunning views of the Smokies. Start your morning with a cup of coffee while watching the sunrise, or enjoy a glass of wine as the sun sets behind the rolling hills. The decks are equipped with plush lounge seating and an outdoor dining area, making them the perfect spots for gathering, relaxing, and soaking in the beauty of nature.

MULTIPLE RECREATION AREAS -
Entertainment is never in short supply here. The game room is a true highlight, offering a pool table, classic arcade games, a game table, and board games to keep everyone entertained. Whether you’re engaging in a friendly competition or simply enjoying a laid-back movie night on one of the four Smart TVs, this cabin is designed for fun.

The first floor of the cabin has a game room complete with -
• Full-size pool table
• 3 Multi-game arcade games
• TVs in all bedrooms and the game room
• Hot Tub with stunning views of the mountains
• Full-size stacked washer and dryer
• Cozy seating
• Large outdoor wrap-around deck

Main floor (2nd story) -
• Large living room the heart of the cabin with a Smart TV
• Large gas fireplace (Oct-March)
• Large outdoor wrap-around decks with stunning views and ample seating.
• TVs located in the bedroom on the main level

BEDROOMS -
Main Level (sleeps 2 people)
• Luxurious California King bed, Smart TV, and ensuite bathroom with a soaking tub & walk-in shower.

Lower floor (sleeps 10 people) -
• Stunning bedroom with California king bed, smart TV, and ensuite bathroom with shower tub combo
• Bedroom with 2 sets of twin beds and smart TV.
• Hall bathroom with shower tub combo
• A queen-sized pullout sofa and futon are available in the game room.

ADDITIONAL AMENITIES –
• Cozy Hot tub in the mountain air
• High-speed Wi-Fi internet access
• Pet friendly with a fee
• Stacked washer and dryer available to use during your stay.
• Heating & A/C
• Parking for 4- 5 standard-size vehicles.
• The fireplace is unavailable April 1st - October 1st (Standard for cabins in the area)
• We provide a set of starter supplies to allow you to get settled when you arrive. They include 2 trash bags, 2 dishwasher pods, a paper towel roll, a small liquid dish soap bottle, toilet paper, a small bottle of shampoo, body lotion, body wash, conditioner, and a soap bar for each bathroom, towels, bed, and linens. They are designed so that you are all set when you arrive but not to last the entire trip.
• Convenient location, less than 14 miles from downtown Gatlinburg, and access to all the area has to offer which includes its great restaurants, shopping & Smoky Mountain National Park.
• Only 9 Miles to Pigeon Forge & 13 miles away from the entrance to Dollywood/Splash Country!
• Our proximity to the Great Smoky Mountain National Park means there is lots of wildlife in our area - black bears, deer, wild turkeys, raccoons, coyotes, foxes, and more! Black bears visit the cabin often in Spring, Summer, and Fall. You may get lucky and catch a glimpse of one of these residents while enjoying the view from the deck. We also contract regular monthly pest services which treat all pests from multiple types of bugs, mice, etc. Despite our regular treatments, given the proximity of the cabin to the park, it is possible these pests can temporarily enter the cabin. We immediately respond and treat if anything comes up and have found it is very rare to come across anything like this.

### Other Details to Note

We continue to take extra precautions to ensure extra cleanliness and prioritize guest safety:

• All hard & soft surfaces cleaned with Micro-Ban™ including counters, vanities, sinks, floors, stair rails, cabinets, doors, furniture, beds, pillows, carpets, comforters, etc. throughout the cabin.
• Lysol™ is used thoroughly on all compatible surfaces to clean and disinfect
• Bleach-based cleaners used in all bathrooms and kitchens, that allow the use of chlorine products.
• Linens (bedding, towels, etc.) – removed & washed offsite in temperatures exceeding those recommended for laundry operations, then packaged until the housekeeping staff is ready to put them out for guests.
• Hot Tub -- Drained, cleaned, fresh Bromine added and refilled after every guest
• The cabin is inspected regularly after cleaning and inspectors perform additional applications of protective products in the cabin, such as MicroBan and Lysol.
• Cleaning staff received additional education on disinfection protocols and are furnished with protective gloves, changing them for fresh pairs as needed during cleaning & disinfection of the home.
• 2 Pets allowed with a fee. Fee is $219
• Please note that pet fees are automatically charged through Airbnb when pets are listed in the guest count.

MINI-GOLF AND EXCELLENT RECREATION AREAS

#### Neighborhood

We are located in the perfect location for your Smoky Mountain stay! Positioned in Gatlinburg Arts & Crafts Community, which is a quiet mountain community providing easy access to many special craft and local shops along with fantastic restaurants and yet only 3.4 miles to the Gatlinburg downtown and less than 8 to Pigeon Forge!

Our close proximity to the Great Smoky Mountain National Park means there is lots of wildlife in our area - black bears, deer, wild turkeys, raccoons, coyotes, fox, and more! Black bears visit the cabin often in Spring, Summer and Fall. You may get lucky and catch a glimpse of one of these residents while enjoying the view from the deck. We also contract regular monthly pest services which treat for all pests from multiple types of bugs, mice, etc. Despite our regular treatments, given the proximity of the cabin to the park, it is possible these pests can temporarily enter the cabin. Other local attractions can be found in downtown Pigeon Forge or Gatlinburg, including delectable restaurants, intriguing shops, the always-entertaining alpine slides, and even a moonshine distillery! During your time here, make sure to visit the Ober Gatlinburg Amusement Park & Ski Area, which offers terrific skiing in the colder months, a ski mountain coaster, an aerial tramway, and many other thrilling attractions!

The cabin is located on a mountain road. We strongly recommend trip insurance, especially during the Winter since there are no refunds for snow and ice. ## Bear Crossing Cabin

Pigeon Forge, TN, United States



14 guests

4 bedrooms

3 bathrooms

Bear Crossing Cabin is a 4-bedroom/3 bath, 2,592 sqft, cabin providing a mountain retreat, with private movie theater, multiple game rooms, beautiful view of the mountains, located less than 1 mile from the Pigeon Forge Parkway. This 3 story cabin sleeps 14 people & packed with activities designed for your entertainment including hot tub, beautiful view, pool table, foosball, arcade games, custom log poker table, movie theater, community pool, kitchen stocked with all major cooking utensils, etc

### Good to know

Plan your perfect spring escape at our cozy cabin, where fresh mountain air, blooming landscapes, and peaceful surroundings create the perfect setting for a relaxing getaway. Start your mornings on the porch with a cup of coffee, take in the sights and sounds of nature coming back to life, and unwind as the sun sets behind the mountains. Your springtime retreat is waiting. Come make it yours!

This Cabin just completed an extensive floor-to-ceiling renovation complete with all new furniture and appliances! Enjoy a wonderful stay at this exquisite mountain retreat located less than a mile from the Pigeon Forge Parkway!

MULTIPLE RECREATION AREAS
You never need to leave the cabin to enjoy your vacation with three separate entertainment areas to enjoy! The cabin is packed with everything from a movie theater, classic pool table, foosball, poker table, arcade games, hot tub, TVs and more! The top and bottom floor recreation rooms are each complete with a wet bar and mini-fridge so you never have to leave!

• Cable TV & Netflix available plus ability to log into any other major streaming app
• Large outdoor deck with rocking chairs & ring toss game
• Corn hole board and bean bags
• Game cabinet with assorted board games

Main floor (2nd story):

• Wrap around exterior deck with gas BBQ, outdoor dining table and wooden rockers

Third floor Recreation Room:

• Custom arcade video game unit (no charge) with 60+ classic arcade games
• Foosball table
• Full size pool table
• Large outdoor deck with 4 wooden rocking chairs and a stunning view of the rolling hills
• Wet bar with sink, mini-fridge and cabinet space
• 50” HD TV and full cable service & Netflix
• Gas burning fireplace

BEDROOMS
The cabin sleeps up to 14 guests with 4 comfortable bedrooms and two pull out queen sofas. Each bedroom is appointed with beautiful cabin themed quilts, hand crafted log frame beds and cozy comforters.

First floor (sleeps 6 people):
• Bedroom with 2 bed bunks (4 total twin beds)
• Bedroom with 1 king bed
• Full bathroom with shower and tub

Main floor (2nd story – sleeps 6 people):
• Bedroom with King bed and 32” HD TV and full cable service & Netflix
• Two pull-out sofa beds (Queen) in the Living Room
• Full bathroom with a shower and tub

Third floor (sleeps 2 people):
• Master Suite with King bed and 40” HD TV and full cable service & Netflix
• Newly remodeled Bathroom with full shower & jetted Jacuzzi tub

KITCHEN, DINING & LIVING ROOM – The main floor of this cabin is perfectly built for entertaining! The well-appointed kitchen, filled with new appliances (January 2021) and all the major utensils, silverware, dishes, glasses and cookware needed for you to create & serve gourmet meals opens to the dining room and living room. There is a large peninsula with four bar stools that separates the kitchen and dining room. The dining table is a custom, log-wood, table built for 8 people and sits along side the bar seating for 4, allowing 12 people to comfortably dine and still watch the living room 50” HD TV or enjoy a fire in the fireplace. The living room is ready for you to relax and enjoy on the three, plush leather couches (2 that are queen sofa beds). Fireplace season is October through March.

BALCONY / DECKS - 3 Balconies, wooden rocking chair seating on each floor, dining table, hot tub, gas BBQ connected to main gas line and stunning views of the mountains

ADDITIONAL AMENITIES –
• Access to a community pool area, complete with a full sized pool, a small children’s splash pool, lawn chairs and lounge area. These facilities are included with your stay with seasonal swimming pools available from Memorial Day through Labor Day.
• High speed Wi-Fi
• Natural Gas Grill – connected to the main gas line so no worry about running out of propane
• Convenient location, only 0.8 miles from the Pigeon Forge Parkway and access to all the area has to offer which includes its great restaurants, shopping, the Island, and Dollywood.
• Only 3 miles away from the entrance to Dollywood/Splash Country!
• Convenient location to all downtown Gatlinburg has to offer which include its great restaurants, shopping, Ripley's Aquarium, Ober Gatlinburg Ski Resort, & the entrance to The Great Smoky Mountains National Park all only a 15 min drive (7 miles) away.

## Juniper Lodge

Welcome to Juniper Lodge, your ultimate luxury mountain retreat! This spacious 8-bedroom cabin is designed for unforgettable family vacations, group getaways, and memory-making in the mountains. From your private heated indoor pool and covered mini golf area to a game-packed recreation room, relaxing hot tub, fire pit, and spacious decks with stunning mountain views, Juniper Lodge brings resort-style entertainment right to your cabin.

### Good to know

We’re thrilled to welcome you to Juniper Lodge, our newest cabin! With years of experience hosting guests in the Smokies and over 2,000+ 5-star reviews across our properties, we’re committed to providing an exceptional stay. While this is a new account for properties we manage on behalf of friends and family, rest assured that your experience will be nothing short of spectacular.

Juniper Lodge sleeps 20 and is located in For By Grace Resort, a hidden treasure in the heart of Sevierville, Tennessee, within picturesque Sevier County. This charming community blends serene natural beauty with modern convenience, making it an ideal retreat for families and groups looking to experience the Smoky Mountains together. Outdoor enthusiasts will love easy access to the Great Smoky Mountains and the area’s many outdoor adventures, while nearby attractions, shopping, dining, and entertainment mean there is something for everyone to enjoy.

Entertainment is endless at Juniper Lodge. Head downstairs to the game room and let the friendly competition begin with ping pong, air hockey, foosball, arcade games, and a 75-inch Smart TV. Whether the kids are battling it out in the arcade, the adults are starting a foosball tournament, or everyone is relaxing together with a favorite show, this space was designed for hours of fun. When you’re ready to make a splash, your large private heated indoor pool awaits. Heated to 85 degrees and featuring basketball goals, it’s perfect for year-round swimming and endless family fun. Then head up to the top deck for another one of Juniper Lodge’s standout amenities, your own covered private mini golf/putt-putt area!

At Juniper Lodge, you’re not just booking a cabin, you’re booking your own private mountain resort, where every day can be filled with swimming, games, mini golf, mountain views, fireside evenings, and unforgettable time together. Book your stay and let the memories begin!

KITCHEN -
The kitchen is designed to make cooking for a crowd easy and enjoyable. Featuring granite countertops, a large kitchen island, stainless steel appliances, plenty of counter space, and a fully stocked kitchen with cooking essentials, you’ll have everything you need to prepare family breakfasts, homemade dinners, and late-night snacks. The open-concept design connects the kitchen to the dining and living spaces, so no one has to miss out on the fun while preparing meals. A large dining table provides plenty of seating for the group, while the spacious outdoor dining area gives you another beautiful place to gather for meals surrounded by fresh mountain air and stunning views.

OUTDOOR AREAS AND DECKS-
The outdoor spaces at Juniper Lodge are a true mountain retreat. Gather around the fire pit with comfortable seating, share a meal at the large outdoor dining table, or fire up one of the two charcoal grills for a family cookout while taking in the stunning mountain views. The lower deck offers even more room to unwind, featuring comfortable couch seating around the fire pit, two swings, and a private hot tub. Sink into the hot tub after a day of exploring or settle into one of the swings and enjoy the peaceful mountain surroundings. And don’t miss one of Juniper Lodge’s most unique amenities! Head to the top deck for your covered private mini golf/putt-putt area and see who in the family can claim bragging rights for the rest of the vacation.

RECREATION AREA -
The recreation areas at Juniper Lodge are your destination for fun, laughter, and unforgettable family competition. The game room is loaded with entertainment, featuring ping pong, air hockey, foosball, arcade games like Ms. Pacman, and a 75-inch Smart TV. Just steps away is the large private heated indoor pool, complete with basketball goals for even more fun. The pool is heated to 85 degrees, making it a fantastic place to swim, play, and relax throughout your stay. From family tournaments to rainy-day entertainment, there’s something here for guests of all ages.

The cabin is located in For By Grace Resort, a hidden treasure in the heart of Sevierville, Tennessee, within picturesque Sevier County. This charming community blends serene natural beauty with modern living, making it an ideal retreat for families, retirees, or anyone seeking a peaceful lifestyle surrounded by the great outdoors. Outdoor enthusiasts will love the easy access to the Great Smoky Mountains, nearby hiking and fishing, local shops, dining, and recreational attractions. It's truly something for everyone in this idyllic Tennessee community.

Our close proximity to the Great Smoky Mountain National Park means there is lots of wildlife in our area - black bears, deer, wild turkeys, raccoons, coyotes, fox, and more! Black bears visit the cabin often in Spring, Summer, and Fall. You may get lucky and catch a glimpse of one of these residents while enjoying the view from the deck. When you've had enough relaxation, look forward to endless entertainment in the surrounding area; you'll be in the perfect spot to explore through winding hiking trails and world-class ski slopes in the Great Smoky Mountains. Other local attractions can be found in downtown Pigeon Forge or Gatlinburg, including delectable restaurants, intriguing shops, the always-entertaining alpine slides, and even a moonshine distillery! During your time here, make sure to visit the Ober Gatlinburg Amusement Park & Ski Area, which offers terrific skiing in the colder months, a ski mountain coaster, an aerial tramway, and many other thrilling attractions!

The cabin is located in the beautiful For By Grace Resort, featuring well-maintained grounds and paved mountain roads leading to the property. While the roads are generally easy to navigate in normal conditions, mountain weather can change quickly. During the winter months, we strongly recommend a 4-wheel-drive or all-wheel-drive vehicle, especially when snow, ice, or heavy rain is expected. Two-wheel-drive vehicles may have difficulty navigating the mountain roads during inclement weather. We strongly recommend trip insurance, especially during the Winter, since there are no refunds for snow and ice. In difficult winter or storm-related weather situations, there can be delays in cleaning and check-in pending road conditions, which can be outside of our control.

We are located in the perfect location for your Smoky Mountain stay! Positioned in Gatlinburg Arts & Crafts Community, which is a quiet mountain community providing easy access to many special craft and local shops along with fantastic restaurants, and yet only 3 miles to the Gatlinburg downtown and less than 8 miles to Pigeon Forge!

Our close proximity to the Great Smoky Mountain National Park means there is lots of wildlife in our area - black bears, deer, wild turkeys, raccoons, coyotes, fox, and more! Black bears visit the cabin often in Spring, Summer and Fall. You may get lucky and catch a glimpse of one of these residents while enjoying the view from the deck. We also contract regular monthly pest services which treat for all pests including multiple types of bugs, mice, etc. Despite our regular treatments, given the proximity of the cabin to the park, it is possible these pests can temporarily enter the cabin. We immediately respond and treat if anything comes up, and have found it is rare to come across anything like this.

When you've had enough relaxation, look forward to endless entertainment in the surrounding area; you'll be in the perfect spot to explore through winding hiking trails and world-class ski slopes in the Great Smoky Mountains. Other local attractions can be found in downtown Pigeon Forge or Gatlinburg, including delectable restaurants, intriguing shops, the always-entertaining alpine slides, and even a moonshine distillery! During your time here, make sure to visit the Ober Gatlinburg Amusement Park & Ski Area, which offers terrific skiing in the colder months, a ski mountain coaster, an aerial tramway, and many other thrilling attractions!

The cabin is located on a mountain road. We strongly recommend trip insurance, especially during the Winter, since there are no refunds for snow and ice. In difficult winter or storm-related weather situations, there can be delays in cleaning and check-in pending road conditions, which can be outside of our control.
